item.title: Man killed at Lawrence City Hall had schizophrenia, was stranded during trip, his sister says
item.description: The Minnesota man shot and killed in Lawrence City Hall last week had schizophrenia and was distressed after being stranded en route to his grandmother, according to his friend and his sister. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas governor revels in triumphs, warns against succumbing to ‘uncivilized’ D.C. politics
item.description: Gov. Laura Kelly said during her State of the State speech that Kansas would have suffered in managing the government, advancing economic activity and elevating the quality of life if voters had chosen a governor who confused toxicity for leadership. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas House Speaker touts Republican supermajority’s ‘people-first agenda’
item.description: Kansas House Speaker Dan Hawkins underscored the force of the Republican supermajority and its 2025 policy wins in his response to Democratic Gov. Laura Kelly’s final State of the State address. Continue reading ...

item.title: Plans for a family emergency shelter in Lawrence have fallen through
item.description: A shelter for families experiencing homelessness in Lawrence will not come to fruition because of a lack of funding, a city staff member told the Lawrence City Commission Tuesday evening. Continue reading ...

item.title: Proposed bill bans gender changes on Kansas driver’s licenses, birth certificates

item.title: Haskell cultural center’s first student exhibitor says creating is medicine
item.description: Marina DeCora’s solo show, "ReVision," roves through themes of mental and community health, reconnection and attachment to land. It's the first student exhibition at the Haskell Cultural Center and Museum. Continue reading ...
